name: ap-sql-assistant
description: AP-SQL Assistant — Version 10.4. Adds Live Shared Schema: a zero-configuration, unauthenticated, same-origin auto-load of a well-known JSON file (default path: schema/shared-schema.json, relative to wherever this app is hosted) on every page load and periodically thereafter. This closes the gap left by V10.3's administrator-only sync mechanisms (File System Access API and GitHub Sync with a Personal Access Token) — with V10.4, ANY user opening the Read Only Query Builder or Query Builder for CR on ANY device or browser automatically benefits from whatever schema an administrator has published, with absolutely no setup on the consuming side. An administrator publishes for everyone simply by pointing GitHub Sync's File Path at this same well-known location (now the default suggested value) — once pushed and GitHub Pages rebuilds, every device/browser picks it up on its next load or periodic check. A new shared-schema-loader.js module implements this (fully unit-testable via an injectable fetch, exactly like github-sync-engine.js). Every existing feature from V10.3 and earlier — GitHub Sync, File System Access sync, description-driven query building, data-type-aware Decode, the Error Rectifier, order-independent multi-table joins, Define Relationship, and localStorage persistence — continues to work exactly as before.
